newsitem.title: CHINA: SHANGHAI ICBC LENDS 500M YUAN TO ELECTRIC GROUP.
newsitem.headline: SHANGHAI ICBC LENDS 500M YUAN TO ELECTRIC GROUP.

text.p: The Shanghai branch of China's biggest bank, the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC), will lend 500 million yuan ($60 million) to a local electric company this year, Xinhua news agency said.
ICBC lent the company, East China Electrical Power Group, two billion yuan in 1996, the official news agency said in a report late on Sunday.
The additional funds would go to financing the company's infrastructure and technical renovation projects, Xinhua quoted company officials as saying.
The terms and length of the loans were not detailed.
ICBC Shanghai said it would also lend the company more to finance state-level electrical power projects, it said.
The company could also expect new fund-raising means such as discount loans, and more banking services such as overseas loans and corporate bonds from the bank, it said.
